speaker: Hrist
original_jp: そう取ってくれるのなら幸いだが <PART> ――
original_en: You can thank me if you want,

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: 助けたつもりはない これが世界を救う最〓の策と〓断したまでだ
original_en:
but I did it to save the world, not you.
It was the best available option.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 今も心はオーディンにあるってか？
original_en: So...your heart still sides with Odin?

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: 世界があっての神 <PART> ――
original_en: Gods don't belong to worlds.

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: 神があっての世界ではないお前は今 それに気づきかけているのだ
original_en:
Nor do worlds belong to gods.
You're finally starting to realize that.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: 先を急ごう
original_en: We should go.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: この世界じゃ まだ今いるこの場がすべてって事か…
original_en:
This is it. This entire world is laid
out in front of us.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: 手は打ってある <PART> ――
original_en: There is a way.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: これは …水〓？
original_en: Is that from the Water Mirror?

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: 私に言わせれば それはオーディンの自業自得だがな…
original_en: If you ask me, Odin wrought this upon himself.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: だからって全部なくなっちまったら俺もあんたも みんな困るんだぜ
original_en:
Even so, it's us who'll be sorry if
everything's wiped out.

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: ドラゴンオーブはここに…グングニルはレザードの手にあるんだな？
original_en:
The Dragon Orb is here with us, and
Gungnir is with Lezard, right?

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: …冗談じゃねえ
original_en: Screw that.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: またか… でもなぜ…？
original_en: But why here?

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: 閉じた世界をつなぐ唯一の〓だいざとなれば戻る事はできる
original_en:
The sole window connecting the closed
world with ours. Return is possible.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: 安定のための力を破壊に利用すればその度に力は〓えてゆく <PART> ――
original_en:
Each time the stabilizing power is used
for destruction, the orb grows weaker.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: …そういう事だ
original_en: Well spoken.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: おそらく レザードはこの先にいる <PART> ――
original_en: Lezard must have already moved on.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: 不死者が知ったふうな事を…
original_en: As if the undead would know.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: もうアスガルドへも ミッドガルドへも戻れないのね…
original_en:
There's no going back now.
Not to Midgard, not to Asgard.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: とはいえもはや アスガルドもさらなる荒廃を免れまい…
original_en:
However, Asgard also faces inevitable
destruction as we speak.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: 世界を護る四宝のうち 二つまでもがこの異世界にあるという事だ
original_en:
Meaning two of the Four Treasures that
sustain our world are here in this one.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: …私にもよくわからない
original_en: I don't know anymore.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: …今度ばかりは本当に助けてくれたみたいだな
original_en:
Looks like this time, you really did
save me.

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: …そのとおりだな
original_en: How right you are.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: それは…
original_en: Well...

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: そういう話はオーディンとレザードにしてあげてください
original_en:
This is something we should be
discussing with Odin and Lezard.

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: フッ…
original_en: Hmph.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: いっそ今すぐオーブで 全部焼き払っちまうわけにいかねえのか？
original_en:
Is there a reason why we just don't burn
this world to ash with the Dragon Orb?

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: ミッドガルドを見限る覚悟があればそれもいいが…
original_en:
If you're willing to say goodbye to
Midgard, then go ahead.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: この波動は レナス…
original_en: I sense...Lenneth.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 創造されたばかりの世界…
original_en: Imagine, a new world...
